description: The shapefile classifies Alberta areas as suitable, unsuitable or uncertain for waste-management siting. It derives the classification from bedrock topography/morphology, inferred buried aquifers, surficial and bedrock geology, and drift thickness. Lakes and areas with insufficient information are masked. The source thus establishes a specific engineered-facility siting use for supporting geological data. Classification uncertainty and the assumption that channel talwegs identify aquifers remain explicit. Only descriptive metadata endpoints appear in the returned distribution list; no shapefile or numerical classification was fetched. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown.
